statement.zh: **术语**：后量子混合方案（Post-Quantum Hybrids）。IR 8547 §3.2 给出定义式描述：「The migration to post-quantum cryptography may initially include hybrid solutions that incorporate the use of quantum-resistant and quantum-vulnerable algorithms」，即迁移初期同时使用后量子与传统算法。
statement.en: **Term**: Post-Quantum Hybrids.It is registered under post-quantum cryptography.

statement.zh: 混合的价值在于不把安全性押在单一组件上：同节说明「These hybrid solutions are typically designed to remain secure if at least one of the component algorithms is secure」。§1 也把立即行动的动因归于「harvest now, decrypt later」威胁，混合部署让机构在替换尚未完成时仍能降低风险。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in post-quantum cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 可验证的使用形式包括混合密钥建立与双签名：文件写明「NIST will accommodate the use of a hybrid key-establishment mode and dual signatures in FIPS 140 validation when suitably combined with a NIST-approved scheme」，并在 §3.2.2 说明「The verification of the dual signature requires all of the component signatures to be successfully verified」——两种组合的判定方式并不相同。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 混合是过渡措施而非永久方案，但它并不会因传统分量被禁用而立刻失去合规路径：§3.2 把混合限定为迁移初期「may initially include」的做法，§4 规定量子脆弱的公钥密码 2030 年后弃用、2035 年后在 NIST 标准与指南下禁用；同一文件写明「The generic composite key-establishment technique is allowed, even if T is derived from an unapproved source (including a disallowed algorithm)」，§4.1.2 又说「at least one of the inputs to an approved composite (i.e., hybrid) key-establishment technique comes from an approved key-establishment scheme」时「the combination can be FIPS 140-validated, even if other inputs are disallowed」，§3.2.2 对双签名亦规定「at least one component digital signature algorithm is NIST-approved」。限制因此落在组件选择上：§4.1.2 记录此时获批的后量子公钥密钥建立方案只有 ML-KEM。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 时间线由同一份文件给出：§1 引用行政要求，令最高敏感系统在 2030 年 12 月 31 日前完成密钥建立迁移、「adopt PQC for key establishment by December 31, 2030, and for digital signatures by December 31, 2031」；§4 另列「support TLS version 1.3 no later than January 2, 2030」等时限；§1 说明三份 PQC 标准已经发布、§2.1 逐一列出它们，§3.2 在此之上允许混合方案与双签名的 FIPS 140 验证路径。
statement.en: Registered period: Post-quantum Era.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
